en.s: The Battle of Dushi Ford was fought between the warlords Cao Cao and Yuan Shao between 3 February and 2 March 200 in the late Eastern Han dynasty. In the battle, Yuan Shao launched an attack on Cao Cao's position on the southern bank of the Yellow River, taking advantage of Cao's temporary absence.

zh.s: 渡口之战发生于东汉末年，曹操与袁绍的军队于200年2月3日至3月2日交战。袁绍趁曹操暂时离开，在黄河南岸袭击曹操的阵地。

en.s: The siege of Rome took place on 2 March 537 – 12 March 538 AD and it was the city's first siege during the Gothic War (535–554) between the defending Byzantine Empire's forces under the leadership of General Belisarius against a numerically superior Ostrogothic (Goths) force under King Vitiges. The siege was the first major encounter between the forces of the two opponents, and played a decisive role in the subsequent development of the war.

zh.s: 537年3月2日至538年3月12日，罗马在535—554年哥特战争中首次遭到围攻。贝利萨留将军率拜占庭帝国军守城，对抗维提吉斯国王统率、人数占优的东哥特军队。这是双方军队首次重大交锋，对战争之后的发展起了决定性作用。

en.t: Louis V succeeds Lothair as king of the Franks
en.s: After Lothair died on 2 March 986, his son Louis V, who had already been crowned, succeeded him as king without opposition.

zh.t: 路易五世继承父亲洛泰尔，成为法兰克国王
zh.s: 986年3月2日，洛泰尔去世。此前已加冕的儿子路易五世继承王位，没有遇到反对。

en.t: Skanderbeg organizes a group of Albanian nobles to form the League of Lezhë
en.s: The League of Lezhë (Albanian: Lidhja e Lezhës), also commonly referred to as the Albanian League (Albanian: Lidhja Arbërore), was a military and diplomatic alliance of the Albanian aristocracy, created in the city of Lezhë on 2 March 1444.

zh.t: 斯坎德培组织阿尔巴尼亚贵族结成莱什联盟
zh.s: 莱什联盟（阿尔巴尼亚语：Lidhja e Lezhës），也称阿尔巴尼亚联盟（阿尔巴尼亚语：Lidhja Arbërore），是阿尔巴尼亚贵族于1444年3月2日在莱什城建立的军事和外交联盟。

en.s: Skanderbeg's Albanian campaign was a military campaign during the years of 1443-1444 commanded by Albanian "hero" Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg, who upon his desertion of the Ottoman army, sought out to liberate the Albanian lands under Ottoman rule. The campaign would culminate in the capture of several crucial cities and fortresses, as well as the formation of the League of Lezhë.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 斯坎德培阿尔巴尼亚战役（1443—1444年）
zh.s: 1443至1444年，阿尔巴尼亚民族英雄格尔吉·卡斯特里奥蒂·斯坎德培率军发动阿尔巴尼亚战役。他脱离奥斯曼军队后，试图解放奥斯曼统治下的阿尔巴尼亚领土。战役最终夺取了数座重要城市和要塞，并促成莱什联盟的成立。

en.t: George of Poděbrady is elected King of Bohemia in Prague
en.s: On 2 March 1458, the Bohemian Diet elected George of Poděbrady king in Prague. Members of both Utraquist and Catholic groups supported his election.

zh.t: 乔治·波杰布拉德在布拉格当选波希米亚国王
zh.s: 1458年3月2日，波希米亚议会在布拉格选举乔治·波杰布拉德为国王。乌特拉奎派和天主教派成员都支持他当选。

en.s: The Battle of Grandson was fought on 2 March 1476, during the Burgundian Wars, and resulted in a major defeat for Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy, at the hands of the Old Swiss Confederacy.

zh.s: 格朗松战役发生于1476年3月2日，是勃艮第战争的一部分。勃艮第公爵大胆查理在战斗中被旧瑞士邦联大败。

en.t: Richard III grants a charter incorporating the College of Arms
en.s: On 2 March 1484, King Richard III granted the royal heralds a charter of incorporation and a house in London for their records.

zh.t: 理查三世颁布特许状，正式设立纹章院
zh.s: 1484年3月2日，英格兰国王理查三世颁布特许状，将王室纹章官正式组成纹章院，并拨给他们伦敦的一处房屋存放档案。

en.s: The battle of Cadore, also known as the battle of Rio Secco or Rusecco, took place near Pieve di Cadore during the opening phase of the War of the League of Cambrai, part of the Italian Wars, on 2 March 1508, opposing the Venetian armies commanded by Bartolomeo d'Alviano and those of the Holy Roman Empire under the leadership of Sixt von Trautson.

zh.s: 1508年3月2日，意大利战争中的康布雷同盟战争初期，巴尔托洛梅奥·达尔维亚诺指挥威尼斯军队，与西克斯特·冯·特劳特松率领的神圣罗马帝国军队，在皮耶韦迪卡多雷附近交战。此战也称里奥塞科或鲁塞科战役。

en.s: The Battle of Borgerhout was a battle during the Eighty Years' War, of the Spanish Army of Flanders led by Alexander Farnese, Prince of Parma, upon a fortified camp at the village of Borgerhout, near Antwerp, where several thousand French, English, Scottish, and Walloon soldiers in service of the recently created Union of Utrecht were stationed.

zh.s: 博赫尔豪特战役是八十年战争期间的一场战斗。帕尔马公爵亚历山大·法尔内塞率领西属尼德兰军队，进攻安特卫普附近博赫尔豪特村的一处设防营地。营地里驻扎着数千名法国、英国、苏格兰和瓦隆士兵，他们效忠于新成立的乌得勒支同盟。

en.s: The Siege of Pärnu (Polish: Parnawa) took place between February 28 and March 2, 1609 during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). The Polish-Lithuanian hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz, while resting his forces in Birże (Biržai), learned of Swedish deployments from Pärnu (present day Estonia) moving towards Daugavgrīva (in present day Latvia) and set out to cut these off. However the Swedish units managed to enter Daugavgrīva before Chodkiewicz's arrival and as a result the hetman turned back and moved towards Pärnu, hoping to take the defenders there under command of Daniel von Wochen by surprise.

zh.s: 1609年2月28日至3月2日，波兰—瑞典战争期间发生派尔努围城战。波兰立陶宛统帅扬·卡罗尔·霍德凯维奇在比尔扎伊休整时，得知瑞军从派尔努，也就是今爱沙尼亚境内，向今拉脱维亚的道加夫格里瓦调动，便出发拦截。但瑞军在他抵达前已进入道加夫格里瓦，他因此转向派尔努，希望突袭丹尼尔·冯·沃亨指挥的当地守军。

en.s: The Great Fire of Meireki (明暦の大火, Meireki no taika), also known as the Great Furisode Fire, destroyed 60–70% of Edo (now Tokyo), then de facto capital city of Japan, on 2 March 1657, the third year of the Meireki Era. The fire lasted for three days and, in combination with a severe blizzard that quickly followed, is estimated to have killed over 100,000 people.

zh.s: 1657年3月2日，明历三年，日本实际上的首都江户，也就是今东京，发生明历大火，又称振袖大火。火灾持续三天，焚毁城市60%至70%的区域，随后迅速袭来的猛烈暴风雪又加重灾情，估计共造成十万多人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of La Guaira (also known as the Battle of La Guayra) took place between 2–5 March 1743 in the Caribbean, off the coast of La Guaira, present day Venezuela. La Guaira was a port of the Royal Gipuzkoan Company of Caracas, whose ships had rendered great assistance to the Spanish navy during War of Jenkins' Ear in carrying troops, arms, stores and ammunition from Spain to her colonies, and its destruction would be a severe blow both to the Company and the Spanish Government.

zh.s: 拉瓜伊拉海战也称拉瓜伊拉之战，发生于1743年3月2日至5日，地点在加勒比海、今委内瑞拉拉瓜伊拉近海。拉瓜伊拉是皇家卡拉卡斯吉普斯夸公司的一座港口。珍金斯耳之战期间，该公司的船只曾为西班牙海军运送士兵、武器、物资和弹药，提供重要帮助；若港口被摧毁，将给公司和西班牙政府带来沉重打击。

en.s: The Battle of Rajamahal was a military engagement fought in 1747 in Jaipur, India. The battle was fought between the forces of Sawai Maharaja Ishwari Singh and Maharana Jagat Singh, who wanted to make his nephew Madho Singh the Maharaja of Jaipur or secure a Jagir for him, he built an alliance with the Maratha's under Khanderao Holkar and the Hada clan of Bundi and Kota.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拉贾马哈尔战役是1747年在印度斋浦尔进行的一场军事冲突，交战双方是萨瓦伊·马哈拉贾·伊什瓦里·辛格的军队和马哈拉纳·贾加特·辛格的军队。贾加特·辛格想让侄子马多·辛格成为斋浦尔大君，或为他取得一块封地，因此与霍尔卡尔家族的坎德拉奥·霍尔卡尔及邦迪、科塔的哈达家族结盟。

en.s: The Battle of the Rice Boats, also called the Battle of Yamacraw Bluff, was a land and naval battle of the American Revolutionary War that took place in and around the Savannah River on the border between the Province of Georgia and the Province of South Carolina on March 2 and 3, 1776. The battle pitted the Patriot militia from Georgia and South Carolina against a small fleet of the Royal Navy.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: Patriot militia units attempt to prevent capture of supply ships in and around the Savannah River by a small fleet of the Royal Navy in the Battle of the Rice Boats.

zh.s: 稻船之战又称亚马克劳崖之战，是美国独立战争期间在陆地和海上发生的一场战斗。1776年3月2日至3日，战斗在萨凡纳河及其周边展开，交战双方是佐治亚和南卡罗来纳的爱国者民兵与一支英国皇家海军小舰队。
zh.n: 美国独立战争：爱国者民兵试图阻止英国皇家海军小舰队在萨凡纳河及周边扣押补给船，这场战斗被称为稻船之战。

en.s: The siege of Maastricht was a failed siege of the city of Maastricht by the forces of the French First Republic from 6 February to 2 March 1793, marking the final action of the 1793 campaign of the War of the First Coalition. The city was successfully defended by the Dutch garrison with the assistance of a small band of French Royalists.

zh.t: 马斯特里赫特围城战（1793年）
zh.s: 1793年2月6日至3月2日，法兰西第一共和国军队围攻马斯特里赫特，但未能攻下。这是第一次反法同盟战争1793年战役的最后一场军事行动。荷兰守军在一小队法国保王党人的协助下成功守住了城市。

en.s: Fédon's rebellion (also known as the Brigands' War, or Fédon's Revolution; 2 March 1795 – 19 June 1796) was an uprising against British rule in Grenada. Although a significant number of slaves were involved, they fought on both sides (the majority being on the side of Fédon and his forces).

zh.s: 费东起义，又称“匪徒战争”或费东革命，于1795年3月2日至1796年6月19日在格林纳达进行，反抗英国统治。大量奴隶参战，双方阵营中都有他们的身影，但多数支持费东及其部队。

en.t: Bonaparte is appointed to command the Army of Italy
en.s: On 2 March 1796, after the resignation of General Barthélemy Schérer was accepted, Napoleon Bonaparte was appointed to command the French Army of Italy. He took command of the army at Nice on 27 March.
en.n: This entry records the appointment date; Bonaparte took command at Nice on 27 March 1796.

zh.t: 波拿巴获任意大利军团司令
zh.s: 1796年3月2日，巴泰勒米·谢雷将军辞职获准后，拿破仑·波拿巴被任命为法国意大利军团司令。他于3月27日在尼斯正式接掌军队。
zh.n: 此条记录的是任命日期；波拿巴于1796年3月27日在尼斯接掌军队。

en.s: The 1796 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held between March 1 and 2, 1796 in order to elect the first governor of Tennessee. Democratic-Republican nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from North Carolina's 5th district John Sevier ran unopposed and thus won the election, but the exact election results are unknown.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1796年3月1日至2日，田纳西州举行州长选举，选出首任州长。民主共和党候选人、曾任北卡罗来纳州第五选区联邦众议员的约翰·塞维尔没有对手，因此赢得选举；不过具体票数不详。

en.s: The Act Prohibiting Importation of Slaves of 1807 (2 Stat. 426, enacted March 2, 1807) is a United States federal law that prohibits the importation of slaves into the United States. It took effect on January 1, 1808, the earliest date permitted by the United States Constitution. This legislation was promoted by President Thomas Jefferson, who called for its enactment in his 1806 State of the Union address.

zh.s: 1807年《禁止输入奴隶法案》（《美国法令大全》第2卷第426页）是一部美国联邦法律，禁止向美国输入奴隶。法案于1807年3月2日通过，并于1808年1月1日生效，这是美国宪法允许的最早日期。托马斯·杰斐逊总统推动了这项立法，并在1806年的国情咨文中呼吁通过法案。

en.s: The Action of 2 March 1808 was a minor naval battle between the Royal Navy's 18-gun Cruizer-class brig-sloop HMS Sappho, and the 28-gun, Danish two-decker brig Admiral Yawl, during the Gunboat War. Sappho, under the command of Captain George Langford, discovered and chased Admiral Yawl, which was steering a course in order to cut off several merchant vessels to leeward. After a short engagement Sappho captured the Admiral Yawl, commanded by Jørgen Jørgensen. Admiral Yawl appears in references under a variety of names including Admiral Yorol and Admiral Juul.

zh.s: 1808年3月2日，炮舰战争期间，英国皇家海军装有18门炮的巡洋舰级双桅战舰“萨福”号，与装有28门炮的丹麦双层甲板双桅船“亚乌尔海军上将”号交战。乔治·兰福德舰长发现丹麦船正驶向下风方向，企图截击数艘商船，随即追击。短暂战斗后，“萨福”号俘获了约恩·约恩森指挥的丹麦船。该船在资料中也称“约罗尔海军上将”号或“尤尔海军上将”号。

en.s: The Battle of San Nicolás was a naval engagement on 2 March 1811 on the Paraná River between the Spanish royalists from Montevideo, and the first flotilla created by the revolutionary government of Buenos Aires. It was the first engagement between the two fleets in the Río de la Plata region since the revolution, and a royalist victory.

zh.s: 圣尼古拉斯海战于1811年3月2日在巴拉那河上爆发，交战双方是蒙得维的亚的西班牙保王派和布宜诺斯艾利斯革命政府组建的第一支舰队。这是革命爆发后双方舰队在拉普拉塔河地区的首次交战，最终保王派获胜。

en.s: In the history of Sri Lanka, the Kandyan Convention (Sinhala: උඩරට ගිවිසුම, romanized: Udarata Giwisuma) was a treaty signed on 2 March 1815 between the British governor of Ceylon, Sir Robert Brownrigg, and the chiefs of the Kandyan Kingdom, British Ceylon, whereas, according to the Sinhala version of the Convention, the signatories were the chiefs of Sihale (note 1), for the deposition of King Sri Vikrama Rajasinha and ceding of the kingdom's territory to the British Crown.

zh.s: 在斯里兰卡历史上，康提条约（僧伽罗语：උඩරට ගිවිසුම，罗马字：Udarata Giwisuma）是锡兰英国总督罗伯特·布朗里格爵士与康提王国首领于1815年3月2日签署的条约。根据僧伽罗语版本，签署方是锡哈莱的首领（注一）。条约废黜了国王斯里·维克拉玛·拉贾辛哈，并将王国领土割让给英国王室。

en.s: The siege of Salvador occurred during the Brazilian War of Independence, during which the newly formed Brazilian army, under the command of French general Pierre Labatut, attempted to capture the city of Salvador in Bahia from its Portuguese defenders. The siege lasted from 2 March 1822 until 2 July 1823, finally ending when the Portuguese commander, Madeira de Melo, surrendered his forces to the Brazilians.

zh.s: 巴西独立战争期间，新成立的巴西军队在法国将军皮埃尔·拉巴图指挥下，围攻葡萄牙守军控制的巴伊亚萨尔瓦多市。围城从1822年3月2日持续至1823年7月2日，最终葡军指挥官马德拉·德梅洛率部向巴西军投降。

en.s: The Texas Declaration of Independence was the formal declaration of independence of the Republic of Texas from Mexico in the Texas Revolution. It was adopted at the Convention of 1836 at Washington-on-the-Brazos on March 2, 1836, and formally signed the following day after mistakes were noted in the text.

zh.s: 《得克萨斯独立宣言》是得克萨斯革命期间，得克萨斯共和国正式宣布脱离墨西哥的文件。1836年3月2日，宣言在布拉索斯河畔华盛顿召开的1836年大会上通过。由于发现文本有错误，正式签署延至次日。

en.s: The battle of Agua Dulce Creek was a skirmish during the Texas Revolution between Mexican troops and the colonists of the Mexican province of Texas, known as Texians. As part of the Goliad Campaign to retake the Texas Gulf Coast, Mexican troops ambushed a group of Texians on March 2, 1836. The skirmish began approximately 26 miles (42 km) south of San Patricio, in territory belonging to the Mexican state of Tamaulipas.

zh.s: 阿瓜杜尔塞河战役是得克萨斯革命期间墨西哥军队与墨西哥得克萨斯省殖民者（称为“得克萨斯人”）之间的一场小规模战斗。1836年3月2日，墨西哥军队在戈利亚德战役行动中伏击了一群得克萨斯人，试图夺回得克萨斯湾岸。冲突发生在圣帕特里西奥以南约26英里（42公里）的塔毛利帕斯州境内。

en.s: The Battle of Whampoa was fought between British and Chinese forces at Whampoa Island (modern-day Pazhou Island) on the Pearl River near the city of Canton (Guangzhou), Guangdong, China, on 2 March 1841 during the First Opium War.

zh.s: 1841年3月2日，第一次鸦片战争期间，英国与清朝军队在广东广州附近珠江上的黄埔岛，也就是今琶洲岛交战。

en.s: The Fight at Aldie was a small cavalry skirmish between Confederate forces under Major John S. Mosby and Union forces under Major Joseph Gilmore and Captain Franklin T. Huntoon in Aldie, Virginia, on March 2, 1863, as part of Mosby's Operations in Northern Virginia during the American Civil War. The fight which resulted in a Confederate victory was significant in that it was the first action of Mosby's Rangers within their operating territory in the central Loudoun Valley.

zh.s: 1863年3月2日，美国南北战争期间，约翰·S.莫斯比少校率邦联军，与约瑟夫·吉尔摩少校及富兰克林·T.亨通上尉率领的联邦军，在弗吉尼亚州奥尔迪进行小规模骑兵交战。此战属于莫斯比在北弗吉尼亚的行动，邦联军获胜。它的重要性在于，这是莫斯比游骑兵首次在其劳登谷中部活动区内作战。

en.s: The Battle of Walkerton was an engagement of the American Civil War. It occurred March 2, 1864, in Walkerton, King and Queen County, Virginia during the campaign known as the Kilpatrick-Dahlgren Raid or the Dahlgren Affair. The campaign started with Brig. Gen. Hugh Judson Kilpatrick leaving Stevensburg on February 28 with 4,000 men, intending to raid Richmond. The force rode along the Virginia Central Railroad tearing up track, while an advance force was sent south along the James River. The plan was that the advance force, led by Col. Ulric Dahlgren, son of Rear Admiral John Dahlgren, should penetrate Richmond's defenses from the rear, and release prisoners at Belle Isle.

en.s: The East Cape War, sometimes also called the East Coast War, was a series of conflicts fought in the North Island of New Zealand from April 1865 to October 1866 between colonial and Māori military forces. At least five separate campaigns were fought in the area during a period of relative peace in the long-running 19th century New Zealand wars. The east coast hostilities came at the close of the Waikato wars and before the outbreak of Te Kooti's War, both fought nearby, but sprang from causes more closely related to the Second Taranaki War—namely, Māori resentment of punitive government land confiscation coupled with the rise of the so-called Hauhau movement, an extremist part of the Pai Marire religion (also called the Hauhau), which was strongly opposed to the alienation of Māori land and eager to strengthen Māori identity. Pai Mārire arrived on the east coast from Taranaki about 1865. The subsequent ritual killing of missionary Carl Volkner by Pai Mārire followers at Opotiki on 2 March 1865 sparked settler fears of an outbreak of violence and later that year the New Zealand government launched a lengthy expedition to hunt for Volkner's killers and neutralise the movement's influence.

zh.s: 东角战争，也称东海岸战争，是1865年4月至1866年10月新西兰北岛殖民军与毛利武装之间的一系列冲突。在19世纪长期的新西兰战争中，这一阶段其他地区相对平静，但东海岸至少进行了五场独立战事。它发生在附近的怀卡托战争结束后、蒂库蒂战争爆发前，不过起因更接近第二次塔拉纳基战争：毛利人不满政府惩罚性没收土地，加上派马里雷宗教中被称为“豪豪运动”的激进派兴起。该运动强烈反对毛利土地被剥夺，希望强化毛利身份认同。派马里雷信仰约于1865年从塔拉纳基传入东海岸。1865年3月2日，其信众在奥波蒂基以仪式方式杀害传教士卡尔·福尔克纳，使殖民者担心暴力将全面爆发。同年稍后，新西兰政府发动长期远征，追捕凶手并消除该运动的影响。

en.s: The 1962 Burmese coup d'état on 2 March 1962 marked the beginning of authoritarian rule and the political dominance of the army in Burma (now Myanmar) which spanned the course of 26 years. In the coup, the military replaced the civilian AFPFL-government, headed by Prime Minister U Nu, with the Union Revolutionary Council, Chaired by General Ne Win. In the first 12 years following the coup, the country was ruled under martial law, and saw a significant expansion in the military's role in the national economy, politics, and state bureaucracy.

zh.s: 1962年3月2日的缅甸政变，标志着持续26年的威权统治和军方主导政治局面的开始。军方推翻吴努总理领导的反法西斯人民自由同盟文官政府，由奈温将军任主席的联邦革命委员会取而代之。政变后的头12年，全国实行军法统治，军方在经济、政治及国家官僚体系中的作用显著扩大。

en.s: Wilt Chamberlain set the single-game scoring record in the National Basketball Association (NBA) by scoring 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors in a 169–147 win over the New York Knicks on March 2, 1962, at Hershey Sports Arena in Hershey, Pennsylvania, United States. It is widely considered one of the greatest records in basketball history.

en.s: Operation Rolling Thunder was a gradual and sustained aerial bombardment campaign conducted by the United States (U.S.) 2nd Air Division (later Seventh Air Force), U.S. Navy, and Republic of Vietnam Air Force (RVNAF) against North Vietnam from 2 March 1965 until 2 November 1968, during the Vietnam War.

en.s: The 1968 South Australian State election was held in South Australia on 2 March 1968. All 39 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election; 38 of the 39 contests were won by candidates from Australia's two major political parties. en.s: The 1968 Football League Cup final took place on 2 March 1968 at Wembley Stadium. It was the eighth final and the second to be played at Wembley. It was contested between Arsenal and Leeds United. Terry Cooper scored the only goal of the game, hammering home a long-range goal after 20 minutes. It was the first major trophy of Don Revie's reign at Elland Road and started the most successful period in the club's history.

zh.s: 1968年英格兰足球联赛杯决赛于3月2日在温布利球场举行。这是该赛事第八届决赛，也是第二次在温布利举行。阿森纳对阵利兹联。特里·库珀在第20分钟远射破门，打入全场唯一进球。这是唐·里维执教利兹联期间赢得的首个重要奖杯，也开启了俱乐部最成功的时期。

en.s: The Battle of Huế (31 January 1968 – 2 March 1968) was a major battle in the Tết Offensive launched by North Vietnam and the Việt Cộng during the Vietnam War. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 2 March 1969. The Front of Socialist Unity (FUS), which had been formed a year earlier to replace the People's Democratic Front (FDP), was the only organization that contested the election; no prospective candidate could run for office without the Front's prior approval. Like the People's Democratic Front, the Front of Socialist Unity was dominated by the Romanian Communist Party (PCR).

en.s: The Sino-Soviet border conflict, also known as the Sino-Soviet crisis, was a seven-month undeclared military conflict between the Soviet Union and China in 1969, following the Sino-Soviet split. The most serious border clash, which brought the world's two largest socialist states to the brink of war, occurred near Damansky (Zhenbao) Island on the Ussuri (Wusuli) River in Manchuria. Clashes also took place in Xinjiang.

zh.s: 中苏边界冲突又称中苏危机，是1969年苏联与中国之间持续七个月、未正式宣战的军事冲突，发生在中苏交恶之后。双方最严重的边境冲突发生在满洲乌苏里江上的珍宝岛附近，一度使世界上两个最大的社会主义国家濒临战争。新疆也发生过冲突。

en.t: The Smith regime puts Southern Rhodesia’s republican constitution into force
en.s: On 2 March 1970, the Smith regime said its new republican constitution had come into force, replacing the British Crown with an acting president as head of state. The U.S. State Department noted that there had been no formal announcement that the republic had come into existence, while Britain treated it as established; the United States continued to regard the United Kingdom as the lawful sovereign.
en.n: This records the constitution taking effect on 2 March 1970; the source distinguishes this from the later dissolution of Parliament on 3 March and says there was no formal announcement of the republic’s establishment.

zh.t: 史密斯政权在南罗得西亚实施共和宪法
zh.s: 1970年3月2日，史密斯政权称新的共和宪法开始生效，以代理总统取代英国王室担任国家元首。美国国务院的文件指出，当天并没有正式宣布共和国成立；英国认为共和国已经建立，美国则继续承认英国对南罗得西亚拥有主权。
zh.n: 此条记载的是共和宪法于1970年3月2日生效。美国国务院文件将这件事与3月3日议会解散区分开来，并指出当天没有正式宣布共和国成立。

en.s: On March 2, 1972, local time, Pioneer 10 launched from Cape Kennedy in Florida, United States, on a mission to explore Jupiter.

en.s: The 1974 Football League Cup final was the final match of the 1973–74 Football League Cup, the 14th season of the Football League Cup, a football competition for the 92 teams in The Football League. The match was played at Wembley Stadium on 2 March 1974, and was contested by two First Division clubs, Manchester City and Wolverhampton Wanderers.

en.s: The election to the Berlin House of Representatives occurred on March 2, 1975. The election campaign was marked by the kidnapping of the CDU top candidate, Peter Lorenz. Lorenz was kidnapped three days before the election by 2 June Movement who demanded the release of six of their comrades. This left incumbent SPD mayor Klaus Schütz in the somewhat awkward position of having to determine, so to speak, the life of his challenger.

zh.s: 1975年3月2日，柏林众议院举行选举。竞选期间，基民盟头号候选人彼得·洛伦茨遭到绑架。选举前三天，六月二日运动绑架了洛伦茨，并要求释放六名同伴。时任社民党市长克劳斯·施ütz因此陷入尴尬境地，不得不决定是否满足绑架者要求，以挽救竞争对手的性命。

en.t: Declaration on the Establishment of the Authority of the People
en.s: The Declaration on the Establishment of the Authority of the People (Arabic: إعلان قيام سلطة الشعب) was brought into force on 2 March 1977 by the General People's Congress, under the auspices of Muammar Gaddafi, in the name of the Arab people of the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya. The Declaration set the constitutional framework of the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, and was considered part of its constitution alongside the Great Green Charter of Human Rights issued in 1988.

zh.s: 《人民权力建立宣言》（阿拉伯语：إعلان قيام سلطة الشعب）于1977年3月2日由全国人民大会在穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲支持下颁布，代表利比亚阿拉伯共和国人民宣布生效。宣言规定了利比亚阿拉伯共和国的宪法框架，并被视为该国宪法的一部分；1988年颁布的《绿色人权宪章》也被视为宪法组成部分。

en.s: The Ilford North by-election of 2 March 1978 was held after the death of Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Millie Miller on 29 October 1977. The seat was gained by the Conservatives in a defeat for James Callaghan's government.

en.t: As a cosmonaut on Soyuz 28, Czechoslovak military pilot Vladimír Remek (pictured) became the first person from outside the Soviet Union or the United States to go into space
en.s: Soyuz 28 (Russian: Союз 28, Union 28) was a March 1978 Soviet crewed mission to the orbiting Salyut 6 space station. It was the fourth mission to the station, the third successful docking, and the second visit to the resident crew launched in Soyuz 26. Cosmonaut Vladimír Remek from Czechoslovakia became the first person launched into space who was not a citizen of the United States or the Soviet Union.

zh.t: 捷克斯洛伐克军方飞行员弗拉基米尔·雷梅克乘坐联盟28号进入太空，成为首位来自美苏以外国家的航天员
zh.s: 联盟28号（俄语：Союз 28，意为“联盟28”）是苏联于1978年3月执行的一次载人航天任务，飞往礼炮6号空间站。这是前往该空间站的第四次任务、第三次成功对接，也是对联盟26号发射的常驻乘组的第二次访问。来自捷克斯洛伐克的航天员弗拉基米尔·雷梅克成为首位进入太空、且不是美国或苏联公民的人。

en.s: The Assault of Ayacucho prison was an incident that occurred in the Peruvian city of Ayacucho (also known as Huamanga) on 2 March 1982. A group of 150 armed terrorists, members of the Sendero Luminoso, or Shining Path, staged simultaneous assaults on two local police stations before staging an assault on the prison, resulting in the release of 255 inmates.

en.t: U.S. forces attack a withdrawing Iraqi armored convoy near Rumaila
en.s: On 2 March 1991, the U.S. 24th Infantry Division attacked a withdrawing Iraqi Republican Guard armored convoy near the Rumaila oil field in southern Iraq. The engagement took place after the U.S.-declared ceasefire and remains controversial.

zh.t: 美军在鲁迈拉附近攻击撤退中的伊拉克装甲车队

en.s: The Pakrac clash, known in Croatia as the Battle of Pakrac (Croatian: Bitka za Pakrac), was a bloodless skirmish that took place in the Croatian town of Pakrac in March 1991. The clash was a result of increasing ethnic tensions in Croatia during the breakup of Yugoslavia. It was one of the first serious outbreaks of violence in what became the Croatian War of Independence.

zh.s: 帕克拉茨冲突在克罗地亚也称帕克拉茨战役（克罗地亚语：Bitka za Pakrac），是1991年3月发生在克罗地亚帕克拉茨镇的一场未造成人员伤亡的冲突。冲突源于南斯拉夫解体期间克罗地亚族群紧张局势不断升高，也是后来克罗地亚独立战争中最早的严重暴力事件之一。

For the event – W-1's first at Ryōgoku Kokugikan – the promotion collaborated with American promotion Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), the first of two W-1/TNA joint events in 2014 (along with Bound for Glory). The event was split into two parts; part one included four matches featuring exclusively Japanese wrestlers, and part two featured eight matches involving wrestlers from TNA.

en.s: The 2014 Football League Cup final was a football match that took place on 2 March 2014 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 2013–14 Football League Cup, the 54th season of the Football League Cup, a football competition for the 92 teams in the Premier League and The Football League. The match was contested by Premier League clubs Manchester City and Sunderland.

en.s: The 86th Academy Awards ceremony, presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), honored the best films of 2013 and took place on March 2, 2014, at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, Los Angeles, beginning at 5:30 p.m. PST / 8:30 p.m. EST. The ceremony was scheduled well after its usual late-February date to avoid conflicting with the 2014 Winter Olympics.

zh.s: 第86届奥斯卡颁奖典礼由美国电影艺术与科学学院举办，于2014年3月2日在洛杉矶好莱坞杜比剧院举行，表彰2013年的优秀电影。典礼在太平洋标准时间下午5时30分、美国东部标准时间晚8时30分开始。为避免与2014年冬奥会撞期，典礼比通常的2月底日期明显推迟。

en.s: The 2014 President's Cup was the inaugural President's Cup. The match was played between 2013 League of Ireland Premier Division champions, St Patrick's Athletic, and 2013 FAI Cup Final winners Sligo Rovers at Richmond Park on 2 March 2014. The match finished 1–0 to St Patrick's Athletic, with Keith Fahey scoring with a right-footed volley top the top right corner from 25 yards after 18 minutes.

en.t: Scott Kelly and Mikhail Kornienko return after 340 days in space
en.s: On March 2, 2016, Scott Kelly and Mikhail Kornienko landed in Kazakhstan aboard Soyuz TMA-18M after 340 days in space. Sergey Volkov returned with them.
en.n: The landing occurred on March 2 in Kazakhstan and UTC, but on the evening of March 1 in U.S. Eastern Standard Time.

zh.t: 凯利和科尔尼延科结束340天太空任务返回地球
zh.s: 2016年3月2日，斯科特·凯利和米哈伊尔·科尔尼延科乘联盟TMA-18M飞船在哈萨克斯坦着陆，结束了340天的太空任务。谢尔盖·沃尔科夫与他们一同返回。
zh.n: 着陆时，哈萨克斯坦当地日期和协调世界时均为3月2日，美国东部标准时间仍是3月1日晚。

en.s: The Palmyra offensive in 2017 was launched by the Syrian Arab Army against the armed forces of the Islamic State (IS) in the Eastern Homs Governorate in January 2017, with the goal of recapturing Palmyra and its surrounding countryside. ISIL forces had retaken the city of Palmyra in a sudden offensive from 8 to 11 December, after previously being expelled from it by Syrian government and Russian forces in March 2016. On 2 March 2017, the Syrian Army alongside Russian reinforcement, succeeded again in recapturing the beleaguered city of Palmyra.

zh.s: 2017年1月，叙利亚阿拉伯军在霍姆斯省东部向“伊斯兰国”发动进攻，目标是夺回巴尔米拉及周边乡村。叙利亚政府军与俄军曾于2016年3月将“伊斯兰国”赶出该城，但后者在12月8日至11日突然发动攻势，再次夺城。2017年3月2日，叙军在俄罗斯增援下，又一次夺回饱受战火摧残的巴尔米拉。

en.s: The 2017 Saskatoon Meewasin provincial by-election was held on March 2, 2017 for the Legislative Assembly of Saskatchewan, in the province of Saskatchewan, Canada. The vote was called after the death of incumbent MLA Roger Parent of the Saskatchewan Party, who died of cancer on November 29, 2016. Candidate Ryan Meili won the election, gaining the seat for the New Democratic Party.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Armenia on 2 March 2018. As a result of the 2015 Armenian constitutional referendum, this was the first time in Armenia's history when the president was elected by the National Assembly instead of popular vote. Another outcome of the referendum was that the newly elected president will perform a ceremonial role as the country is currently transitioning from a semi-presidential system to a parliamentary republic.

zh.s: 亚美尼亚于2018年3月2日举行总统选举。根据2015年宪法公投结果，这是该国历史上首次由国民议会、而非全民投票选出总统。该公投也决定将国家从半总统制转为议会共和制，因此新总统主要承担礼仪职责。

en.s: The 2018 Tajik Supercup was the 9th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajik League and Tajik Cup. The match was contested by 2017 Tajik League champions Istiklol, and the 2017 Tajik Cup champions Khujand. It was held at the Central Stadium in Hisor on 2 March 2018. Istiklol won the match 3–2 thanks to an extra-time winner from Nozim Babadjanov.

zh.s: 2018年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第九届赛事，由上赛季塔吉克斯坦联赛冠军对阵塔吉克斯坦杯冠军。比赛于2018年3月2日在希索尔中央体育场举行，由2017年联赛冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔队对阵2017年杯赛冠军胡占德队。伊斯蒂克洛尔队在加时赛中凭借诺齐姆·巴巴詹诺夫的进球，以3比2获胜。

en.s: Snap general elections were held in Guyana on 2 March 2020. They were called early after the government of President David A. However, one of its own MPs, Charrandas Persaud of the Alliance for Change (AFC), voted with the opposition.

en.s: The 2021 Burlington mayoral election was held on March 2, 2021. Incumbent Democratic Mayor Miro Weinberger defeated Progressive nominee Max Tracy, independent Ali Dieng, and various other minor candidates. Weinberger's victory by 129 votes was the smallest margin of victory in Burlington's mayoral elections since Bernie Sanders' ten vote victory in 1981. Weinberger faced no opposition for the Democratic nomination although C.D. Mattison considered running against him.

zh.t: 2021年佛蒙特州伯灵顿市长选举
zh.s: 佛蒙特州伯灵顿于2021年3月2日举行市长选举。民主党现任市长米罗·温伯格击败进步党候选人马克斯·特雷西、独立候选人阿里·迪恩及其他小党派候选人。他仅以129票获胜，是伯尼·桑德斯1981年以10票险胜以来，该市市长选举最小的获胜差距。温伯格在民主党提名中没有对手，尽管C.D.马蒂森曾考虑挑战他。

The sole candidate running within Vietnam's one-party regime, Võ Văn Thưởng, was elected by the National Assembly of Vietnam.

en.s: Since 2 March 2026, there has been an ongoing war in Lebanon between Israel and the militant group Hezbollah, with Israel invading parts of Lebanon. It is a resumption of major fighting in the Hezbollah–Israel conflict, and part of the wider conflict in the Middle East. The war has precipitated a humanitarian crisis, resulted in the deaths of more than 4,000 people from Israeli strikes in Lebanon, and seen the forced displacement of over 1 million. After Hezbollah attacked Israel on October 8, 2023, one day after Hamas October 7 attacks at the start of the Gaza war, led to the 2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon.
